interpretation_qualification: The preregistered dominance criterion passes, but the post-hoc absolute-attribution/gap ratios of 137.36 and 143.47 expose severe electron-ion cancellation. The stable inference is common-operator closure, boundary-drive parity, and a net-space-charge origin; electron and ion terms are not interpreted as independent physical causes.
provenance_note: The rule was committed and pushed before the first Poisson reconstruction or Shapley reduction. The absolute-attribution/gap ratio was added after observing the outcome, is explicitly labeled post hoc, and changes no preregistered metric, gate, threshold, or decision.
